run_head_to_head_evals: run head-to-head agent evaluations across multiple seeds using compare_agents.py with a config and experiment path
run_evals_with_variant: run agent comparison evals with a specific game variant like classic or france-austria
run_evals_for_power: run head-to-head evals filtered to a single power using the --power flag
run_evals_gentle_start: run evals in gentle_start mode that only launches jobs if output is not already running
run_evals_start_missing: run evals in start_missing mode to launch jobs for seeds that have no results yet
